notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Activate Slayers' Stronghold's second ability by paying {R}{W} and tapping it, giving Jegantha +2/+0, vigilance, and haste until end of turn.
Move to your combat phase, and declare Najeela and Jegantha as attackers.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
